question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Nvidia)

calls.reasoning: Q3 FY27 (ended Oct 25, 2026) guidance $108B rev ±2%, 74% GM, GAAP opex $9.2B; Nvidia typically beats, so ~$112B rev puts GAAP EPS before gains at ~$2.56 (consensus non-GAAP $2.47-2.53). calls.reconciliation: Main factual dispute: the SpaceX stake mark over the quarter. Run 1 cited Jul 24 $118.24 and Oct 23 $147.49 (+$3.6B on 122.8M sh); Run 2's prices nearby (Oct 20 $147.79, Aug low $108) agree with that; Run 3 left SpaceX out, which accounts for most of its lower median. I accept Run 1's figure but trim it a little for lock-up/valuation-discount risk and the unchecked smaller stakes. All runs agree Intel and CoreWeave were negative, the post-quarter events don't count, and the core math is ~$2.48 at guide / ~$2.6 at a typical beat. The size of the revenue beat and the private marks are judgment calls; I take $112B and a modest positive private skew.
